title: Post Light Replacement with LED Diode Fixture and Astronomical Timer
summary: This Old House guides a full exterior lighting upgrade centered on replacing a rotted lamp-post, upgrading the switch and wiring, and installing a modern, LED-based lighting ensemble. The video demonstrates removing the old post, pouring a quick-set post foundation, installing a new aluminum post with an LED diode fixture, routing wiring, replacing the wall switch with a weatherproof box and an astronomical time clock, and matching a wall sconce to the new post light for a cohesive exterior look. The sequence emphasizes safety (power shutoff), weatherproofing, and choosing long-lasting, low-maintenance lighting components.
topics: matching exterior fixtures (post light, wall scon, ceiling light)

sections.title: Assess the issue and plan replacement
concepts: identifying a faulty switch
evaluating the condition of the existing post light
deciding to replace the post and switch
sections.description: The segment establishes a faulty wall switch that only powers the light while pressed and previews replacing a deteriorated post with a new LED-based fixture. It frames the plan to swap a non-functional switch and rebuild the exterior lighting post.

sections.title: Remove existing post and access ground wiring
concepts: shrub clearing to access the post
exposing the wiring and disconnecting power
removing the old post
sections.description: The crew clears vegetation, locates and shuts off the circuit breaker, and begins removing the old post. The post is detached and set aside to make way for the new installation.

sections.title: Install new post and LED fixture, route wiring
concepts: new post dimensions (3-inch diameter, 7 ft height)
aluminum post that resists rust
LED diode fixture with standard 120V operation
routing wire up the post through a side hole
sections.description: Joel introduces a new aluminum post designed to be durable and rust-free, compatible with LED fixtures that run on 120V. The work includes positioning the post, placing the wiring through a side access, and preparing the post-base for concrete.

sections.title: Concrete post installation (dry-pack method)
concepts: dry-set concrete for posts
activating concrete with water after placement
initial stability test with a tug
sections.description: A special post-concrete mix is poured dry into the hole; water is added to activate it. The post is tested for sturdiness after setting for about an hour.

sections.title: Diffuser and top assembly for LED post
concepts: LED diffuser to soften light
top assembly on the post
sections.description: A diffuser is installed to soften the LED light, and the top of the post fixture is secured into place to complete the exterior luminaire assembly.

sections.title: Switch box upgrade and timer integration; matching scon
concepts: replace weathered switch box with weatherproof box
install weatherproof cover
introduce an astronomical time clock for dusk-to-dawn operation
match wall scon to post light with LED diode
sections.description: The old switch box is replaced with a weatherproof enclosure; a weatherproof cover is added. An astronomical time clock is installed to automate dusk-to-dawn operation, and a matching LED wall sconcit is added to harmonize the exterior lighting with the new post light.

sections.title: Power restoration and final reveal
concepts: power restored to the circuit
timed lighting schedule activated
final aesthetic: cohesive lighting package
sections.description: Power is restored, the timer is set to begin lighting at dusk, and the new post light alongside the matching scon is showcased as part of a cohesive exterior look.
